# Run Playground

Read `AGENTS.md` and the APC context, then pass the requested outcome to the Playground Orchestrator. Do not require the developer to name specialists. The Orchestrator selects the smallest complete team, sequences dependencies, delegates implementation to Builder, validates, and routes findings.

Preserve human decisions, protected visual foundations, intentional threshold behavior, and existing share-link compatibility. Do not commit, push, create or merge pull requests, approve pull requests, or release.
